art_direction: 成年菲穿芥末黄无袖衬衫与深蓝宽松短裤，靠在海岸汽水小店的栏杆旁，一脚轻搭低台阶，举着透明柠檬汽水杯神气微笑。
composition_variation: Design a fresh anime wallpaper featuring Faye Valentine in her recognizable twenty-three-year-old adult appearance, short violet hair, green eyes, and an amused confident expression. At a small retro seaside soda kiosk, she rests one forearm naturally on a low painted railing and places one foot on a shallow step, holding a clear cup of sparkling lemon soda near shoulder level. Outfit her in an opaque mustard sleeveless button-front shirt with a normal closed neckline, navy loose tailored shorts, and simple canvas sneakers. Keep the pose relaxed, charismatic, and nonsexual. Use sunwashed peach walls, turquoise ocean glimpses, a striped awning edge, and restrained vintage color grading. No writing, brands, weapons, or other people. Her face sits around forty-five percent height, with both hands safely centered. Leave generous clean pale-blue space above for the lock-screen clock.

postprocessing.note: Unmodified native PNG preserved in Codex local artifact directory heroine-summer-10/native. Final wallpaper is cropped and resized, not generated natively at final dimensions.
